question: Who founded DeepMind, and which company acquired it and in what year?

subquestions: Which company acquired DeepMind, and in what year?

args.query: DeepMind acquisition Google 2014 2015 deal year acquired

observations.content:
Summary: DeepMind was founded in 2010 by Demis Hassabis, Shane Legg, and Mustafa Suleyman. The company focuses on artificial general intelligence. Google acquired DeepMind in 2014.

[1] Google DeepMind | History, Innovations, & Controversies
    https://www.britannica.com/topic/Google-DeepMind
    DeepMind was founded in 2010 by Demis Hassabis, Mustafa Suleyman, and Shane Legg. The founders brought together expertise in neuroscience, computer science, and machine learning with the goal of advancing artificial intelligence. Their shared ambition was to create systems capable of general learning and reasoning, rather than narrowly specialized software designed for specific tasks.

### What were DeepMind’s early breakthroughs in AI? [...] ## History

DeepMind was founded in 2010 by Demis Hassabis, Mustafa Suleyman, and Shane Legg to “solve intelligence” by creating artificial general intelligence (AGI). Its approach centered on using machine learning to train neural networks to learn and make decisions in ways that resemble human cognition, rather than programming actions and reactions individually or specializing software for specific tasks (such as playing chess or modeling climate systems). [...] Google DeepMind is an artificial intelligence (AI) research laboratory created through the merger of Google AI’s Google Brain division and the tech start-up DeepMind. As a subsidiary of Alphabet, it focuses on advancing artificial general intelligence (AGI) and developing AI systems for use across Google’s products. The organization is headquartered in London and operates internationally.

Summary: Google acquired DeepMind in 2014 for a reported price between $400 million and $650 million. The acquisition was considered one of Google's most significant moves in the AI sector. DeepMind was later merged with Google Brain in 2023 to form Google DeepMind.

    https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Google_DeepMind
    DeepMind Technologies Limited,trading asGoogle DeepMind or simply DeepMind, is a British-American artificial intelligence (AI) research laboratory which serves as a subsidiary of Alphabet Inc. Founded in the UK in 2010, it was acquired by Google in 2014,( and merged with Google AI's Google Brain division to become Google DeepMind in April 2023. The company is headquartered in London, with research centres in the United States, Canada,( France,( Germany, and Switzerland. [...] On 26 January 2014, Google confirmed its acquisition of DeepMind for a price reportedly ranging between $400 million and $650 million.( The company was afterwards renamed Google DeepMind and kept that name for about two years.( In 2014, DeepMind received the "Company of the Year" award from Cambridge Computer Laboratory.( [...] In December 2019, co-founder Suleyman announced he would be leaving DeepMind to join the parent company Google, working in a policy role.(

In April 2023, DeepMind merged with Google AI's Google Brain division to form Google DeepMind, as part of the company's continued efforts to accelerate work on AI in response to OpenAI's release of ChatGPT to the general public.( This marked the end of a years-long struggle from DeepMind executives to secure greater autonomy from Google.(

Summary: Google acquired DeepMind in January 2014 for a reported $400–650 million. The acquisition was Google's largest in Europe at the time. DeepMind became part of Alphabet's AI research lab.

DeepMind's AlphaGo beats world champion Lee Sedol 4–1 at the ancient game of Go - a landmark long thought to be a decade away - demonstrating deep reinforcement learning at superhuman level and catapulting the lab to global prominence.

Google acquires DeepMind on January 26, 2014 for a reported $400–650 million, in what was then Google's largest European acquisition, keeping the research team based in London.
